description: Source code for a FastAPI-based mock server mimicking AWS Bedrock Guardrail API, including models, guardrail logic, API endpoints, and server startup code.

classes.name: BedrockTextContent
classes.description: Model representing text content in Bedrock API requests/responses.

classes.name: BedrockContentItem
classes.description: Model representing a content item containing BedrockTextContent.

classes.name: BedrockRequest
classes.description: Model representing a request to the Bedrock guardrail API.

classes.name: BedrockGuardrailOutput
classes.description: Model representing output from the guardrail, with optional text.

classes.name: TopicPolicyItem
classes.description: Model representing a topic policy item with name, type, and action.

classes.name: TopicPolicy
classes.description: Model representing a collection of topic policy items.

classes.name: ContentFilterItem
classes.description: Model representing a content filter with type, confidence, and action.

classes.name: ContentPolicy
classes.description: Model representing a collection of content filters.

classes.name: CustomWord
classes.description: Model representing a custom word with match string and action.

classes.name: WordPolicy
classes.description: Model representing word policies including custom words and managed lists.

classes.name: PiiEntity
classes.description: Model representing a PII entity with type, match, and action.

classes.name: RegexMatch
classes.description: Model representing a regex pattern for sensitive info detection.

classes.name: SensitiveInformationPolicy
classes.description: Model representing PII and regex-based sensitive info policies.

classes.name: ContextualGroundingFilter
classes.description: Model representing a filter for contextual grounding with thresholds and actions.

classes.name: ContextualGroundingPolicy
classes.description: Model representing a collection of contextual grounding filters.

classes.name: Assessment
classes.description: Model representing an assessment with various policies.

classes.name: BedrockGuardrailResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response from the guardrail API, including action, outputs, and assessments.

classes.name: GuardrailConfig
classes.description: Model representing configuration for mock guardrail behavior, including blocked words, topics, PII patterns, and token.

classes.name: LitellmBasicGuardrailRequest
classes.description: Model for requests to the LiteLLM guardrail API endpoint.

classes.name: LitellmBasicGuardrailResponse
classes.description: Model for responses from the LiteLLM guardrail API endpoint.

methods.name: verify_bearer_token
methods.description: Verifies the Bearer token from the Authorization header.

methods.name: check_blocked_words
methods.description: Checks if input text contains blocked words.

methods.name: check_blocked_topics
methods.description: Checks if input text contains blocked topics.

methods.name: check_pii
methods.description: Detects PII in text and returns policy and anonymized text.

methods.name: process_guardrail_request
methods.description: Processes a guardrail request and returns the response with interventions.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning service info.

methods.name: beta_litellm_basic_guardrail_api
methods.description: API endpoint to apply guardrail logic to input/output texts.
